changes.title: Explicit self-update
changes.description: ohgo update installs the published release after verifying its SHA-256, and a failed verification restores the previous binary.

changes.title: Complete update lifecycle
changes.description: A successful /update now offers a one-shot What's New acknowledgement on the next interactive launch.

changes.title: Improved TUI update handling
changes.description: The update hint remains informational, installation stays explicit, and the restart requirement is named truthfully.

changes.title: Space jumps to the live edge
changes.description: In the full-screen transcript, `space` returns to the latest line when the composer is idle and the view is scrolled up. A non-empty draft keeps space literal.

changes.title: One-line install
changes.description: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PizenLabs/ohgo/main/install.sh | sh` resolves the latest stable release (or a pinned `OHGO_VERSION`), verifies the tarball against `sha256sums.txt`, smoke-tests the binary, and installs into `$HOME/.local/bin`. A mismatch leaves an existing installation untouched.

changes.title: `/copy` with `-a` and `-c` scopes
changes.description: The default copies the most valuable part of the latest answer without fences; `-a`/`--all` keeps the explanation and every code block, and `-c`/`--context` copies the conversation context. A terminal that cannot accept OSC 52 is reported rather than claiming success.

changes.title: Evidence benchmark suite
changes.description: `go run ./bench/phase9 -suite evidence` measures the five runtime requirement tasks and the authority regression matrix with the real router, security gate, evidence projector, and completion evaluator. It also runs against a live provider with `-live-model`.

changes.title: External-state claims need observation
changes.description: An answer that turns local configuration into a remote fact ("the workflow ran today", "it was pushed") is `NEEDS_REVIEW` unless the run observed the remote surface through a knowledge call, an MCP capability, or a command that talked to a remote.

changes.title: Evidence-aware stop
changes.description: After the first observation turn, a turn that observes the repository without adding a new fact stops informational work from starting another tool round. The decision derives from evidence gain, never from a tool-call count.

changes.title: Repository questions demand evidence
changes.description: Questions about this repository's behaviour ("does this workflow run automatically?") declare a `repository_overview` need that only a content-bearing observation satisfies; a listing or an answer from memory is `NEEDS_REVIEW`.

changes.title: Questions are not execution requests
changes.description: Authority admission no longer escalates an informational question that contains execution or mutation vocabulary, so "I want to ask if this automatically runs" classifies as READ and runs in ASK.

changes.title: "Investigate" routes to FUZZ
changes.description: "Investigate …", "diagnose …", and "troubleshoot …" now classify as INVESTIGATE (FUZZ) instead of falling back to READ.

changes.title: Hosting names are not code symbols
changes.description: Hosting and product names such as "GitHub" are no longer extracted as code symbol targets, so a request that mentions one no longer demands impossible index evidence.
